blocker.description: SQD finalized-stream intermittently returns HTTP 200 with an empty response body. Frozen runner V0.4.2 treats the first such response as SOURCE_CHUNK_BLOCKED instead of retrying the identical request.
blocker.scientific_interpretation: Transport failure only. Empty HTTP 200 is not proof of a zero-event day and must not be converted to NO_EDGE or SOURCE PASS.

transport_remediation_required: Retry the exact same SQD request on HTTP 200 plus empty body with bounded deterministic backoff.
If bounded retries exhaust, remain fail-closed as TECHNICAL/SOURCE_BLOCKED.
Pin workflow checkout to the run SHA rather than a mutable branch name.
Revalidate previously blocked Kamino and Save11 days before authoritative full-range rerun.
Then require complete daily coverage, zero anomalies, known first-success recovery and Official Solana RPC deterministic RAW sample PASS.

execution_constraint.description: The connected GitHub integration allowed documentation/branch operations but blocked executable runner/workflow hardening through its safety checks. No bypass was attempted.
